title: Stuffed Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. chopped fresh mint leaves or 1 tsp. dried mint leaves (15 mL)
4 lbs. lamb leg, deboned and butterflied (2 kg)
directions: Have the butcher debone and butterfly your leg of lamb for you.
In a skillet brown ground pork, drain excess fat. Add onions and saute until transparent.
Add salt, pepper, cinnamon, mint, rice and raisins. Stir until well combined.
Open the leg of lamb and stuff with rice mixture. Re-tie meat.
Roast at 325° F (160° C) for 1 1/4 hours for medium rare.
notes: Newspaper clipping from a 'Consumer Cou[rner?]' column (header cut off)
raw_text:
CONSUMER COU[?]
STUFFED LEG OF LAMB
Have the butcher debone and butterfly your leg of lamb for you.
1/2 lb. ground pork 250 g
1/2 cup chopped onion 125 mL
1/2 tsp. salt 2 mL
1/4 tsp. pepper 1 mL
1/2 tsp. cinnamon 2 mL
1 Tbsp. chopped fresh mint leaves or 1 tsp. dried mint leaves 15 mL
2 cups cooked rice 500 mL
1/2 cup raisins 125 mL
4 lbs. lamb leg, deboned and butterflied 2 kg
In a skillet brown ground pork, drain excess fat. Add onions and saute until transparent. Add salt, pepper, cinnamon, mint, rice and raisins. Stir until well combined. Open the leg of lamb and stuff with rice mixture. Re-tie meat. Roast at 325° F (160° C) for 1 1/4 hours for medium rare.

title: Mushroom beef stroganoff
directions: Mix ground beef with seasonings, minced onion, crumbs, catsup and egg. Shape into one-inch balls.
Brown meatballs in one tbsp hot fat in large skillet. Drain off and discard fat; return drippings to pan.
Drain mushrooms, retaining liquid. Add water to mushroom liquid to total 1 1/2 c. Add mushrooms, water and bouillon cubes to skillet. Simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Mix sour cream and flour. Add to hot mixture; stir gently to combine. Heat but do not boil. Serves five to six.

title: Oriental Spring Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 New Zealand Spring Lamb shoulder chops (or 8 loin chops), thawed
directions: Combine marinade ingredients. Pat chops dry and toss well in marinade. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or over-night (for loin chops 1 hour before grilling).
Nick edges to prevent curling. Place chops on greased grill 4" from hot coals.
Barbecue 5-6 minutes per side for medium rare, turning often.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Sour cream meatballs
ingredients: 1/4 c fine dry bread crumbs (50 mL)
1 can cream of mushroom soup (284 mL)
directions: In medium bowl combine bread crumbs and milk; allow to set for five minutes. Chop onion very fine; add to crumb mixture. Add ground beef, egg, soy sauce, salt and seasonings. Mix well. Shape into 16 meat balls.

Brown meatballs in one tbsp oil in skillet; transfer to three L casserole. Discard fat; add small amount water to skillet; stir to pick up brown bits. Combine with sour cream and mushroom soup. Pour over meatballs in casserole.
Bake uncovered at 375 F (190 C) for 45 minutes. Serve over rice or noodles. Serves four.

title: Irish Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs. lamb, shoulder or butt (1 kg)
directions: Trim fat from lamb and cut meat away from the bone into 1" (2.5 cm) cubes. Place lamb cubes and bone in a large pot and add remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling. Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Skim fat from broth.
Optional: Serve with pickled red cabbage to add crunch and colour to the stew.
notes: Clipping intro: "There are many versions of Irish Stew. The original stew was made from kid, not lamb."
Clipping pasted on a lined page
raw_text:
IRISH STEW
There are many versions of Irish Stew. The original stew was made from kid, not lamb.
2 lbs. lamb, shoulder or butt 1 kg
6 medium potatoes, peeled and sliced 6
3 medium onions, sliced 3
2 tsp. salt 10 mL
1/2 tsp. ground thyme 2 mL
1/4 tsp. pepper 1 mL
1 clove of garlic, minced 1
6 medium carrots, chopped 6
2 cups water 500 mL
Trim fat from lamb and cut meat away from the bone into 1" (2.5 cm) cubes. Place lamb cubes and bone in a large pot and add remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling. Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Skim fat from broth. Optional: Serve with pickled red cabbage to add crunch and colour to the stew.

title: Lancashire Hot Pot
ingredients: 2 cups beef bouillon OR 2 cups left-over gravy
directions: USE a deep casserole, Dutch oven or bean pot.
PEEL and slice potatoes, scrape and slice carrots and peel and slice onions.
ARRANGE a layer of potatoes, carrots and onions, keeping half for top of dish.
PLACE chops on vegetables, season with salt and pepper and add remaining vegetables, ending with potatoes.
POUR bouillon or gravy in, cover pot and cook in oven at 350 degrees or on top of the stove for 3 hours. Uncover to brown potatoes during the last half hour.
SERVE with sliced tomatoes and have fresh, frozen or canned fruit for dessert. (Serves 4.)
notes: 'Reader's Request' column: "My mother made a dish called Lancashire Hot Pot and although none of us have ever been to Lancashire, we'd like to try it in our home."
Weekend Magazine Vol. 8 No. 22, 1958

title: Sicilian Meat Roll
ingredients: 6 oz. (1 1/2 c.) shredded mozzarella cheese, halved diagonally
directions: Combine eggs, bread crumbs, tomato juice, parsley, oregano, salt, pepper & garlic. Stir in ground beef mixing well.
On foil or waxed paper, pat meat to a 12 x 10" rectangle. Arrange ham slices atop meat, leaving a small margin around edges. Sprinkle shredded cheese over ham.
Starting from short end carefully roll up meat, using foil to lift, seal edges & ends. Place roll seam side down in 13x9x2" baking pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hr 15 min or until done. Place cheese wedges over top of roll, return to oven for 5 min. Serves 8.
notes: Serves 8
"halved diagonally" presumably refers to cheese slices for the wedges on top
